audit_title: SKY / CBT — P0 Portfolio Accounting Forensic Repair & Reconciliation

accounting_convention.formula_mtm: Equity_t = Cash_t + sum_{i in Open}(notional_i + unrealized_pnl_i)
accounting_convention.formula_invariant: Equity_t == InitialCash + RealizedGross_t + sum_{i in Open}(unrealized_pnl_i) - TotalFrictions_t - TotalFunding_t

defect_forensic_root_cause.defective_code:
sum(p.unrealized_pnl + p.notional for p in open_positions.values())
current_equity = cash + sum(p.unrealized_pnl for p in open_positions.values())
defect_forensic_root_cause.repaired_code:
open_position_equity = sum(p.notional + p.unrealized_pnl for p in open_positions.values())
current_equity = cash + open_position_equity
defect_forensic_root_cause.impact_description: Reserved position notionals were deducted from cash at trade entry, but omitted from mark-to-market equity during the position holding period. This caused artificial equity crashes down to -$46.40 USD, manufactured an invalid 101.22% max drawdown on a cash-reserved non-leveraged model, heavily distorted position sizing on subsequent trades, and created artificial +800% daily return jumps upon position closure.

scenarios_covered: One long position mark-to-market and cash reserve
One short position mark-to-market and cash reserve
Multiple simultaneous positions across distinct assets
Profitable and losing open positions concurrently
Partial close with proportional notional and fee return
Full close returning all reserved notional and locking realized PnL
Multi-leg entry and exit fees tracking
Funding payments debit for longs and credit for shorts
Consecutive entries and exits without cumulative drift
Duplicate position ID and out-of-order event rejection
Property-based randomized accounting sequences (100 discrete steps)
End-to-end replay engine integration with simulation integrity gates
